title: Visit Billing Limits: Frequency, Units, Telehealth and Filing Deadlines (Insured Plan of Care)
content:
Billing compliance schedule for the **Insured Plan of Care**. Each payer program sets the weekly visit maximum, the cap on timed units in one visit, the method that turns timed minutes into units, whether telehealth is covered, the timely filing deadline and whether missed-visit fees may be billed to the patient.

| Payer program | Weekly visit maximum (Monday to Sunday) | Timed units per visit, maximum | Unit-counting method | Telehealth covered | Timely filing (calendar days after the visit) | Missed-visit fee billable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Plan of Care | 3 | 4 | AMA substantial-portion method | Yes | 90 | Yes |
| Commercial High-Deductible Plan of Care | 3 | 4 | AMA substantial-portion method | Yes | 90 | Yes |
| Commercial POS Plan of Care | 3 | 4 | AMA substantial-portion method | Yes | 90 | Yes |
| Commercial HMO Plan of Care | 3 | 4 | AMA substantial-portion method | Yes | 90 | Yes |
| Medicare Part B Plan of Care | 3 | 6 | CMS 8-minute rule | No | 365 | Yes |
| Medicare Advantage Plan of Care | 3 | 4 | CMS 8-minute rule | Yes | 180 | Yes |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan of Care | 2 | 4 | CMS 8-minute rule | Yes | 365 | No |

## Definitions

- **Weekly visit maximum** — the maximum billed visits per Monday-to-Sunday week under the payer program's frequency guideline.
- **Timed units per visit** — the maximum timed procedure units billed for one visit.
- **Unit-counting method** — how timed minutes convert to billed units: the CMS 8-minute rule counts total timed minutes across codes; the AMA substantial-portion method counts each code on its own minutes.
- **Telehealth covered** — whether the payer program covers physical therapy delivered by telehealth.
- **Timely filing** — the calendar days after the visit date within which the claim must reach the payer; a late claim is written off and never billed to the patient.
- **Missed-visit fee billable** — whether a late-cancellation or no-show fee may be billed to a patient whose visit is funded by the plan.

## Distinguishing the programs

- The Medicare Part B Plan of Care is the only program that does not cover telehealth and the only one allowing 6 timed units in a visit.
- The Medicaid Managed Care Plan of Care is the only program with a weekly maximum of 2 visits and the only one on which a missed-visit fee may not be billed to the patient.
- The three government programs count units by the CMS 8-minute rule; the four commercial programs use the AMA substantial-portion method.
